title: Historic Tucson tower gets a $50M affordable housing makeover
summary_full: Tucson House in Arizona is undergoing a major renovation to provide affordable housing for older adults. The project is expected to create 358 modern apartments by summer 2028, improving accessibility for residents aged 55 and older. Twenty-five households have already moved into the newly renovated 15th-floor apartments within ten months of commencing work. Future updates will include shared amenities such as lounges, fitness rooms, and landscaped courtyards.
